bypassSandboxHelp: Run Codex without sandbox restrictions. Required for filesystem/network access.
enableSearchHelp: Enable Codex web search capability during runs.
fastModeHelp: Enable Codex Fast mode. This burns credits/tokens much faster and is supported on GPT-6, GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and manual Codex model IDs.
fastModeManual: Fast mode will be passed through for this manual model. If Codex rejects it, turn the toggle off.
fastModeCredits: Fast mode consumes credits/tokens much faster than standard Codex runs.
fastModeUnsupported: Fast mode currently only works on {{models}} or manual model IDs. Paperclip will ignore this toggle until the model is switched.
enableChromeHelp: Enable Claude's Chrome integration by passing --chrome.
skipPermissionsHelp: Run unattended by auto-approving adapter permission prompts when supported.
maxTurnsPerRunHelp: Maximum number of agentic turns (tool calls) per heartbeat run.
